7. `tests/test_utils/test_echo_via_pager.py`: 30 cases of `test_echo_via_pager` (the `less` pager variants, `test0`–`test9` except `test5`/`test6`)

The `less` pager failures also show the pager writing an empty file instead of the expected output (e.g. `assert '' == 'just text\n'`). The run also reported `collected 33653 items / 31000 deselected / 2653 selected`, which means the repo's pytest config deselects most tests by default. I ran the command as you specified, so the count reflects that config.

I didn't modify any files. The only file I read was `.pytest_cache/v/cache/lastfailed`, which pytest had written during this run.
